description: This file defines generic functional utilities such as fmap (for applying a function or constructor to elements of a collection) and filter (for selecting elements based on a predicate). It provides implementations for both ArrayRef and vector containers, facilitating functional programming patterns within the PyTorch codebase.

methods.name: std::vector<decltype(fn (* inputs.begin ()))> fmap(const T & inputs,const F & fn)
methods.description: Applies a given function or constructor to each element in the input collection, returning a vector of results.

methods.name: std::vector<T> filter(at::ArrayRef<T> inputs,const F & fn)
methods.description: Filters elements in a collection based on a predicate function, returning a vector of elements satisfying the predicate.

methods.name: std::vector<T> filter(const std::vector<T> & inputs,const F & fn)
